in_marathi.name: Sugrivpal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Strong, Victorious, Lord
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sugrivpal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sugrivpal is a name of great power and strength in Hindu mythology. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'sugriva' meaning strong and 'pal' meaning lord. Sugrivpal is the name of the monkey king, who is a central character in the Indian epic Ramayana.
